response.overview: After a career in science, Sandy Webb has found a new passion in retirement: collecting and cataloguing the diverse algae species that inhabit the waters near her Melbourne home. With the precision of a scientist and the eye of an artist, she transforms her discoveries into exquisite pressed-seaweed specimens, The kelp collector reveals how Sandy's dedication to documenting local marine life connects her to the coastal environment she calls home.
response.title: The kelp collector
